variants.title: A · мягкое круглое лицо
variants.prompt: A natural cinematic photograph of Sonya, a fictional ten-year-old schoolgirl in a science-fiction story, standing beside her drawing desk in a bright, comfortable spacecraft family cabin. She wears a pale-lilac long-sleeved shirt, an oatmeal cardigan and dark trousers, holding a sketchbook. Two long light copper-red braids have tiny clear glass star beads woven into them. Light-blue eyes, softly round face, a few freckles, curious relaxed expression. Handmade pink and lilac bead bracelets. Soft natural indoor light, realistic family-photo atmosphere, no styling or makeup. Horizontal 16:9 composition, show her complete head with space above and upper figure down to the sketchbook. One person only, no text.
variants.scene_edit_prompt: Edit this exact image while preserving Sonya's face, age, hair, braids, clear glass stars, clothes, bracelets, sketchbook, pose, lighting and landscape composition. Replace ONLY the large window and Earth view with a plain built-in pale grey wall panel with a few practical seams, consistent with a windowless spacecraft residential cabin. Keep the room believable and comfortable. Do not change the child or her expression. No view of Earth or outer space.
